The words you and your are singular because Jesus is speaking to the city. But if you decided to say “you people” in 19:42, you could use the plural forms of you and your.

notes.note: Jesus is speaking. To dash something to the ground means to pick it up and throw it forcefully against the ground in order to destroy it. As the first note to 19:42 explains, Jesus is addressing the city of Jerusalem. notes.note: To dash people to the ground means to kill them. Alternate translation: [and they will kill your children within you]
